user.title: Set up DHL (Germany)
user.description:
Open this link in a browser and log in with your DHL Kundenkonto: {authorize_url}

Your browser will fail to open the final `dhllogin://…` redirect — that is expected. Copy the full address from the address bar and paste it below.

reauth_confirm.title: DHL sign-in expired
reauth_confirm.description: DHL no longer accepts the stored session. Open this link, log in again, then paste the redirect URL: {authorize_url}

error.invalid_redirect: That does not look like the DHL redirect URL — make sure you copied the full address after logging in.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach DHL. Please try again.

abort.already_configured: That DHL account is already set up.
abort.cannot_connect: Could not reach DHL. Please try again.
abort.wrong_account: That sign-in is for a different DHL account. Sign in with the account this entry was set up for.

data_description.delivered_filter_type: Show delivered parcels from the last X days, or limit to the X most recent.
data_description.delivered_filter_amount: Number of days or parcels to show.

data_description.include_history: Add a per-parcel history attribute listing each status update (timestamp, status, original text). Off by default.

data_description.refresh_interval: How often the integration checks DHL for parcel updates. A slower interval is gentler on DHL's API; the default of 30 minutes is plenty for most parcels.

track_parcel.name: Track parcel
track_parcel.description: Start tracking a parcel by its DHL tracking number, in addition to whatever your DHL account already shows.

config_entry_id.name: DHL account
config_entry_id.description: Which configured DHL account to add this parcel to. Only needed when more than one is set up.

untrack_parcel.name: Untrack parcel
untrack_parcel.description: Stop tracking a manually-added DHL parcel by its tracking number.

tracking_code.name: Tracking code
tracking_code.description: The DHL tracking number to stop tracking.

config_entry_id.name: DHL account
config_entry_id.description: Which configured DHL account to remove this parcel from. Only needed when more than one is set up.

trigger_type.parcel_delivery_time_changed: A parcel's expected delivery time changed
